_comment: Humanoid (legacy Mixamo-baked rig) skeleton joint map. Decouples PoseSampler from Mixamo conventions by translating semantic joint roles (hips, foot_left, etc.) to this skeleton's actual joint names. This rig is FROZEN -- all existing animation clips (player + Guide + larvae) bake against it. The new MB-Lab-native 'humanoid' rig replaces it actor-by-actor; until full migration, every humanoid actor still references skeleton_id=humanoid_legacy. See docs/design/character-canvas.md.
_lockon_note: Default lockon points for humanoid actors (player + every shade archetype that doesn't author its own list). Single-target (chest). Boss archetypes with multiple targetable parts override entirely in their config/enemies/<id>.json (see wolf.json lockon_points = head/torso/hindleg_*).
